Audience: first-time New Jersey Class D applicants, especially new permit and probationary license holders who fall under the Probationary Driver Program.
Why it matters to a first-timer: the probationary driver rules apply directly to new drivers [A02], and point values for speeding and tailgating are classic exact-figure items [A07].
Level: heavy exact-figure recall (points, thresholds, years, dollars) with a few program rules; high load because many point values look alike.
Prerequisites: the penalties and surcharge basics in the previous section.
